svg.text: Longer proportions / tailored silhouette / quiet confidence
Child cheeks, hair, gaze and wardrobe
are designed separately from the adult.
Pelvis rests on seat; knees bend forward.
Opposing limbs; feet have different jobs.
Head and body turn toward a person.
Bent elbows; adult and child hands overlap.
